intent: Every bomber leaves a thin fading ghost trail behind them, so players can read where rivals have been and are heading before dodging blasts.
accept: Each player has a thin 1px trail path behind them following their recent positions (max 20 points, one per ~16ms)
The trail fades linearly from alpha 0.6 at the newest point to 0 over 2 seconds
The trail is visible in the after clip behind moving players and disappears when they stand still
